description: Provides and manages local Kubernetes clusters optimized for development workflows.

next.name: addons
tip: Enable or disable minikube addons.

next.name: configure
tip: Configure the ADDON_NAME addon within minikube.

option.name: --config-file
tip: An optional config file for reading addon-specific configuration without requiring an interactive prompt.

next.name: disable
tip: Disable the ADDON_NAME addon within minikube.

next.name: enable
tip: Enable the ADDON_NAME addon within minikube.

option.name: --force
tip: If set, perform potentially dangerous operations. Use with caution.

option.name: --images
tip: Images used by this addon. Comma separated.

option.name: --refresh
tip: If true, pods might get deleted and restarted on addon enable.

option.name: --registries
tip: Registries used by this addon. Comma separated.

next.name: images
tip: List image names the ADDON_NAME addon uses.

option.name: --output
tip: Output format. table, json.

next.name: list
tip: List all available minikube addons as well as their current statuses (enabled/disabled).

option.name: --docs
tip: If true, output web links to addon documentation with the list output.

option.name: --output
tip: Output format. json, list.

next.name: open
tip: Open the ADDON_NAME addon within minikube.

option.name: --https
tip: Open the addon URL with https instead of http.

option.name: --interval
tip: The time interval for each check made by wait, in seconds.

option.name: --url
tip: Display the Kubernetes addon URL in the CLI instead of opening it in the default browser.

option.name: --wait
tip: Amount of time to wait for the service, in seconds.

next.name: cache
tip: Add, delete, or reload images in the local cache.

next.name: add
tip: Add an image to the local cache.

option.name: --all
tip: Add images to the cache for all running minikube clusters.

next.name: delete
tip: Delete an image from the local cache.

next.name: list
tip: List all available images in the local cache.

option.name: --format
tip: Go template format string for the cache list output.

next.name: reload
tip: Reload cached images.

next.name: completion
tip: Generate command completion for a specified shell.

next.name: bash
tip: Generate the autocompletion script for bash.

next.name: fish
tip: Generate the autocompletion script for fish.

next.name: powershell
tip: Generate the autocompletion script for PowerShell.

next.name: zsh
tip: Generate the autocompletion script for zsh.

next.name: config
tip: Modify persistent configuration values.

next.name: defaults
tip: List all valid default settings for PROPERTY_NAME.

option.name: --output
tip: Output format. Acceptable values: json, yaml.

next.name: get
tip: Returns the value of PROPERTY_NAME from the minikube config file.

next.name: set
tip: Sets a PROPERTY_NAME config value to PROPERTY_VALUE.

next.name: unset
tip: Unsets a PROPERTY_NAME from the minikube config file.

next.name: view
tip: Display values currently set in the minikube config file.

option.name: --format
tip: Go template format string for the config view output.

next.name: cp
tip: Copy the specified file into minikube, saving it as the target file absolute path.

next.name: dashboard
tip: Access the Kubernetes dashboard running within the minikube cluster.

option.name: --port
tip: The port to expose the dashboard on. Set to 0 to pick a random port.

option.name: --url
tip: Display the dashboard URL instead of opening a browser.

next.name: delete
tip: Delete a local Kubernetes cluster.

option.name: --all
tip: Set flag to delete all profiles.

option.name: --output
tip: Format of the standard output. Options: text, json.

option.name: --purge
tip: Set this flag to delete the '.minikube' folder in your user directory.

next.name: docker-env
tip: Set up docker environment to point the terminal's docker-cli to minikube's internal Docker Engine.

option.name: --no-proxy
tip: Add machine IP to the NO_PROXY environment variable.

option.name: --output
tip: Output format. Options: text, yaml, or json.

option.name: --shell
tip: Force environment to be configured for a specified shell: fish, cmd, powershell, tcsh, bash, zsh.

option.name: --ssh-add
tip: Add the SSH identity key to the SSH authentication agent.

option.name: --ssh-host
tip: Use SSH connection instead of HTTPS connection (port 2376).

option.name: --unset
tip: Unset variables instead of setting them.

next.name: image
tip: Manage images.

next.name: build
tip: Build a container image in minikube.

option.name: --all
tip: Build the image on all nodes.

option.name: --build-env
tip: Environment variables to pass to the build process. (format: key=value)

option.name: --build-opt
tip: Specify arbitrary flags to pass to the build process. (format: key=value)

option.name: --file
tip: Path to the Dockerfile (optional).

option.name: --node
tip: The node to build on. Defaults to the primary control plane.

option.name: --push
tip: Push the new image (requires a tag).

option.name: --tag
tip: The tag to apply to the new image (optional).

next.name: list
tip: List images.

option.name: --format
tip: Format the output. Valid values: short, table, json, yaml.

next.name: load
tip: Load an image into minikube.

option.name: --daemon
tip: Cache the image from the docker daemon.

option.name: --overwrite
tip: Overwrite the image even if the same image:tag exists.

option.name: --pull
tip: Pull the remote image (disables caching).

option.name: --remote
tip: Cache the image in the remote registry.

next.name: pull
tip: Pull an image.

next.name: push
tip: Push an image.

next.name: remove
tip: Remove one or more images.

next.name: save
tip: Save an image from minikube.

option.name: --daemon
tip: Cache the image to the docker daemon.

option.name: --remote
tip: Cache the image to the remote registry.

next.name: tag
tip: Tag an image.

next.name: ip
tip: Retrieve the IP address of the specified node and write to STDOUT.

option.name: --node
tip: The node to get the IP from. Defaults to the primary control plane.

next.name: kubectl
tip: Run a Kubernetes client (kubectl) matching the cluster version, downloading it if necessary.

option.name: --ssh
tip: Use SSH to run the kubernetes client on the node.

next.name: license
tip: Output licenses of dependencies to a directory.

option.name: --dir
tip: Directory to output the licenses to.

next.name: logs
tip: Gets the logs of the running instance, used for debugging minikube, not for user code.

option.name: --audit
tip: Show only the audit log.

option.name: --file
tip: If present, writes to the provided file instead of standard output.

option.name: --follow
tip: Show only the most recent journal entries, and continuously print new entries as they are added to the journal.

option.name: --last-start-only
tip: Show only the logs of the most recent start.

option.name: --length
tip: Number of lines back to go within the logs.

option.name: --node
tip: The node to get logs from. Defaults to the primary control plane.

option.name: --problems
tip: Show only log entries which point to known problems.

next.name: mount
tip: Mounts the specified directory into minikube.

option.name: --9p-version
tip: Specify the 9p version that the mount should use.

option.name: --gid
tip: Default group id used for the mount.

option.name: --ip
tip: Specify the ip that the mount should be setup on.

option.name: --kill
tip: Kill the mount process spawned by minikube start.

option.name: --msize
tip: The number of bytes to use for 9p packet payload.

option.name: --options
tip: Additional mount options, such as cache=fscache.

option.name: --port
tip: Specify the port that the mount should be setup on, where 0 means any free port.

option.name: --type
tip: Specify the mount filesystem type (supported types: 9p).

option.name: --uid
tip: Default user id used for the mount.

next.name: node
tip: Add, delete, or list additional nodes.

next.name: add
tip: Add a node to the given cluster, then start it.

option.name: --control-plane
tip: If set, the added node will be a control plane. Defaults to false.

option.name: --delete-on-failure
tip: If set, delete the current cluster if start fails and retry. Defaults to false.

option.name: --worker
tip: If set, the added node will be available as a worker. Defaults to true.

next.name: delete
tip: Delete a node from a cluster.

next.name: list
tip: List nodes.

next.name: start
tip: Start a node.

option.name: --delete-on-failure
tip: If set, delete the current cluster if start fails and retry. Defaults to false.

next.name: stop
tip: Stop a node in a cluster.

next.name: options
tip: Show a list of global command-line options (applies to all commands).

next.name: pause
tip: Pause Kubernetes.

option.name: --all-namespaces
tip: If set, pause all namespaces.

option.name: --namespaces
tip: Namespaces to pause.

option.name: --output
tip: Format of the standard output. Options: text, json.

next.name: podman-env
tip: Configure environment to use minikube's Podman service.

option.name: --shell
tip: Force environment to be configured for a specified shell: fish, cmd, powershell, tcsh, bash, zsh.

option.name: --unset
tip: Unset variables instead of setting them.

next.name: profile
tip: The profile command sets the current minikube profile, or gets the current profile if no arguments are provided.

next.name: list
tip: List all valid minikube profiles.

option.name: --detailed
tip: If true, returns a detailed list of profiles.

option.name: --light
tip: If true, returns a faster list of profiles by skipping verification of the cluster status.

option.name: --output
tip: The output format. 'json' or 'table'.

next.name: service
tip: Returns the Kubernetes URL(s) for a service in your local cluster.

option.name: --all
tip: Forward all services in the namespace (defaults to false).

option.name: --https
tip: Open the service URL with https instead of http (defaults to false).

option.name: --interval
tip: The initial time interval for each check made by wait, in seconds.

option.name: --namespace
tip: The service namespace.

option.name: --url
tip: Display the Kubernetes service URL in the CLI instead of opening it in the default browser.

option.name: --wait
tip: Amount of time to wait for the service, in seconds.

next.name: list
tip: List the URLs for the services in your local cluster.

option.name: --namespace
tip: The service namespace.

option.name: --output
tip: The output format. 'json' or 'table'.

next.name: ssh
tip: Log into or run a command on a machine with SSH (similar to 'docker-machine ssh').

option.name: --native-ssh
tip: Use the native Golang SSH client (defaults to true).

option.name: --node
tip: The node to ssh into. Defaults to the primary control plane.

next.name: ssh-host
tip: Retrieve the ssh host key of the specified node.

option.name: --append-known
tip: Add host key to the SSH known_hosts file.

option.name: --node
tip: The node to ssh into. Defaults to the primary control plane.

next.name: ssh-key
tip: Retrieve the ssh key path of the specified node and write to STDOUT.

option.name: --node
tip: The node to get the ssh key path from. Defaults to the primary control plane.

next.name: start
tip: Start a local Kubernetes cluster.

option.name: --addons
tip: Enable one or more addons. See `minikube addons list` for available addon names.

option.name: --apiserver-ips
tip: A set of apiserver IP addresses used in the certificate generated for Kubernetes.

option.name: --apiserver-name
tip: The authoritative apiserver hostname used for the apiserver certificate and for connectivity.

option.name: --apiserver-names
tip: A set of apiserver names used in the certificate generated for Kubernetes.

option.name: --apiserver-port
tip: The port the apiserver listens on.

option.name: --auto-pause-interval
tip: The amount of time to wait in the minikube VM before pausing (default 1 minute).

option.name: --auto-update-drivers
tip: If set to true, automatically updates the drivers to the latest version. Defaults to true.

option.name: --base-image
tip: The base image used for the Docker/Podman driver. Used for local deployment.

option.name: --binary-mirror
tip: The source of the kubectl, kubelet, kubeadm binaries.

option.name: --cache-images
tip: If true, cache images for the current bootstrapper and load them into the machine.

option.name: --cert-expiration
tip: The length of time that minikube certificates will be valid for (default three years, 26280 hours).

option.name: --cni
tip: The CNI plugin to use. Options include auto, bridge, calico, cilium, flannel, kindnet, or a path to a CNI manifest.

option.name: --container-runtime
tip: The container runtime to be used. Valid options: docker, cri-o, containerd.

option.name: --cpus
tip: Number of CPUs allocated to Kubernetes. Use "max" for the maximum number of CPUs, or "no-limit" for no limit.

option.name: --cri-socket
tip: The cri socket path to be used.

option.name: --delete-on-failure
tip: If set, delete the current cluster if start fails and retry. Defaults to false.

option.name: --disable-coredns-log
tip: If set, disable CoreDNS verbose logging. Defaults to false.

option.name: --disable-driver-mounts
tip: Disables filesystem mounts provided by the hypervisor.

option.name: --disable-metrics
tip: If set to true, disables metrics reporting (CPU and memory usage), which can improve CPU utilization.

option.name: --disable-optimizations
tip: If set to true, disables optimizations meant for local Kubernetes, including reducing the CoreDNS replica count from 2 to 1.

option.name: --disk-size
tip: Disk size allocated to the minikube VM (format: <number>[<unit>], where unit = b, k, m or g).

option.name: --dns-domain
tip: The cluster DNS domain name used in the Kubernetes cluster.

option.name: --dns-proxy
tip: Enable proxy for NAT DNS requests (virtualbox driver only).

option.name: --docker-env
tip: Environment variables to pass to the Docker daemon. (format: key=value)

option.name: --docker-opt
tip: Specify arbitrary flags to pass to the Docker daemon. (format: key=value)

option.name: --download-only
tip: If true, only download and cache files for later use - do not install or start anything.

option.name: --driver
tip: Driver is one of: virtualbox, hyperv, vmware, qemu2, docker, podman, ssh.

option.name: --dry-run
tip: dry-run mode. Only validates the configuration, does not change system state.

option.name: --embed-certs
tip: If true, will embed the certs in kubeconfig.

option.name: --extra-config
tip: A set of key=value pairs that describe configuration that may be passed to different components.

option.name: --extra-disks
tip: Number of additional disks to create and attach to the minikube VM.

option.name: --feature-gates
tip: A set of key=value pairs that describe feature gates for alpha/experimental features.

option.name: --force
tip: Force minikube to perform possibly unsafe operations.

option.name: --force-systemd
tip: If set, force the container runtime to use systemd as the cgroup manager. Defaults to false.

option.name: --gpus
tip: Allow pods to use your GPUs. Options include: all, nvidia, amd.

option.name: --ha
tip: Create a highly available multi-control-plane cluster with at least three control-plane nodes, which also act as worker nodes.

option.name: --host-dns-resolver
tip: Enable host resolver for NAT DNS requests (virtualbox driver only).

option.name: --host-only-cidr
tip: The CIDR to be used for the minikube VM (virtualbox driver only).

option.name: --host-only-nic-type
tip: NIC type used for the host-only network. One of Am79C970A, Am79C973, 82540EM, 82543GC, 82545EM, or virtio (virtualbox driver only).

option.name: --hyperkit-vpnkit-sock
tip: Location of the VPNKit socket used for networking. If empty, disables the Hyperkit VPNKitSock; if 'auto', uses Docker for Mac VPNKit connection.

option.name: --hyperkit-vsock-ports
tip: List of guest VSock ports that should be exposed as sockets on the host (hyperkit driver only).

option.name: --hyperv-external-adapter
tip: External adapter will be used to create an external switch if an external switch is not found (hyperv driver only).

option.name: --hyperv-use-external-switch
tip: Whether to use an external switch over the default switch if no explicit switch is specified. Only for the hyperv driver.

option.name: --hyperv-virtual-switch
tip: The hyperv virtual switch name. Defaults to the first hyperv virtual switch found (hyperv driver only).

option.name: --image-mirror-country
tip: Country code of the image mirror to be used. Leave empty for the global code. For users in China, set it to cn.

option.name: --image-repository
tip: Alternative image repository to pull docker images from. Set to 'auto' to let minikube choose one for you.

option.name: --insecure-registry
tip: Insecure Docker registries to pass to the Docker daemon. The default service CIDR range is added automatically.

option.name: --install-addons
tip: If set to true, installs the addons. Defaults to true.

option.name: --interactive
tip: Allow user prompts for more information.

option.name: --iso-url
tip: Location of the minikube ISO image.

option.name: --keep-context
tip: This will keep the existing kubectl context and create a minikube context.

option.name: --kubernetes-version
tip: The Kubernetes version that the minikube VM will use (ex: v1.2.3, 'stable', 'latest').

option.name: --kvm-gpu
tip: Enable experimental NVIDIA GPU support in minikube.

option.name: --kvm-hidden
tip: Hide the hypervisor signature from the guest in minikube (kvm2 driver only).

option.name: --kvm-network
tip: The KVM default network name (kvm2 driver only).

option.name: --kvm-numa-count
tip: Simulate the numa node count in minikube. Supported numa node count range is 1-8 (kvm2 driver only).

option.name: --kvm-qemu-uri
tip: The KVM QEMU connection URI (kvm2 driver only).

option.name: --listen-address
tip: IP address to use to expose ports (docker and podman drivers only).

option.name: --memory
tip: Amount of RAM to allocate to Kubernetes (format: <number>[<unit>], where unit = b, k, m or g). Use "max" or "no-limit" for no limit.

option.name: --mount
tip: Kept for backward compatibility, the value will be ignored.

option.name: --mount-9p-version
tip: Specify the 9p version that the mount should use.

option.name: --mount-gid
tip: Default group id used for the mount.

option.name: --mount-ip
tip: Specify the ip that the mount should be setup on.

option.name: --mount-msize
tip: The number of bytes to use for 9p packet payload.

option.name: --mount-options
tip: Additional mount options, such as cache=fscache.

option.name: --mount-port
tip: Specify the port that the mount should be setup on, where 0 means any free port.

option.name: --mount-string
tip: The directory to mount into the guest, formatted as '/host-path:/guest-path'.

option.name: --mount-type
tip: Specify the mount filesystem type (supported types: 9p).

option.name: --mount-uid
tip: Default user id used for the mount.

option.name: --namespace
tip: The named space to activate after start.

option.name: --nat-nic-type
tip: NIC type used for the nat network. One of Am79C970A, Am79C973, 82540EM, 82543GC, 82545EM, or virtio (virtualbox driver only).

option.name: --native-ssh
tip: Use the native Golang SSH client (defaults to true). Set to 'false' to use the command line 'ssh' command when accessing Docker machine.

option.name: --network
tip: Network to run minikube with. Used by docker/podman, qemu, kvm, and vfkit drivers. If left empty, minikube creates a new network.

option.name: --nfs-share
tip: Local folders to share with the guest via NFS mounts (hyperkit driver only).

option.name: --nfs-shares-root
tip: Location of the root for NFS shares, default to /nfsshares (hyperkit driver only).

option.name: --no-kubernetes
tip: If set, the minikube VM/container starts without starting or configuring Kubernetes (only applies to new clusters).

option.name: --no-vtx-check
tip: Disable checking for the availability of hardware virtualization before the VM is started (virtualbox driver only).

option.name: --nodes
tip: The total number of nodes to start. Defaults to 1.

option.name: --output
tip: Format of the standard output. Options: text, json.

option.name: --ports
tip: List of ports that should be exposed (docker and podman driver only).

option.name: --preload
tip: If true, download the tarball of preloaded images when available to improve startup time. Defaults to true.

option.name: --preload-source
tip: Which source to download the preload from (valid options: gcs, github, auto).

option.name: --qemu-firmware-path
tip: Path to the qemu firmware file.

option.name: --registry-mirror
tip: Registry mirrors to pass to the Docker daemon.

option.name: --rosetta
tip: Enable Rosetta to support apps built for Intel processors on a Mac with Apple silicon (vfkit driver only).

option.name: --service-cluster-ip-range
tip: The CIDR to be used for service cluster IPs.

option.name: --socket-vmnet-client-path
tip: Path to the vmnet client binary (QEMU driver only).

option.name: --socket-vmnet-path
tip: Path to the vmnet binary (QEMU driver only).

option.name: --ssh-ip-address
tip: SSH host IP address (SSH driver only).

option.name: --ssh-key
tip: SSH key (SSH driver only).

option.name: --ssh-port
tip: SSH port (SSH driver only).

option.name: --ssh-user
tip: SSH user (SSH driver only).

option.name: --static-ip
tip: Set a static IP for the minikube cluster. The IP must be a private IPv4 address whose last octet is between 2 and 254.

option.name: --subnet
tip: Subnet to use on the kic cluster. If left empty, minikube will select a subnet starting from 192.168.49.0.

option.name: --trace
tip: Send trace events. Options include: gcp.

option.name: --uuid
tip: Provide the VM UUID to restore the MAC address (hyperkit driver only).

option.name: --vm
tip: Filter to use only VM drivers.

option.name: --wait
tip: Comma separated list of Kubernetes components to verify and wait for after starting a cluster. Available options: apiserver, system_pods, default_sa, apps_running, node_ready, kubelet, extra. Other acceptable values are 'all', 'none', 'true' and 'false'.

option.name: --wait-timeout
tip: The maximum amount of time to wait for the Kubernetes/host to be in a healthy state.

next.name: status
tip: Get the status of a local Kubernetes cluster.

option.name: --format
tip: Go template format string for the status output.

option.name: --layout
tip: Output layout (experimental, JSON only): 'nodes' or 'cluster'.

option.name: --node
tip: The node to check the status of. Defaults to the control plane.

option.name: --output
tip: Output format. json or text.

option.name: --watch
tip: Continuously list/get the status at the optional interval.

next.name: stop
tip: Stop a running local Kubernetes cluster.

option.name: --all
tip: Set flag to stop all profiles (clusters).

option.name: --cancel-scheduled
tip: Cancel any existing scheduled stop requests.

option.name: --keep-context-active
tip: Keep the kube-context active after the cluster is stopped. Defaults to false.

option.name: --output
tip: Format of the standard output. Options: text, json.

option.name: --schedule
tip: Set flag to stop the cluster after a certain amount of time (e.g. --schedule=5m).

next.name: tunnel
tip: Tunnel creates a route to services deployed with type LoadBalancer and sets their Ingress to their ClusterIP.

option.name: --bind-address
tip: Set the tunnel bind address. '' or '*' means the tunnel should be available for all interfaces.

option.name: --cleanup
tip: Call with cleanup=true to remove old tunnels.

next.name: unpause
tip: Resume Kubernetes.

option.name: --all-namespaces
tip: If set, unpause all namespaces.

option.name: --namespaces
tip: Namespaces to unpause.

option.name: --output
tip: Format of the standard output. Options: text, json.

next.name: update-check
tip: Print the current and latest versions.

next.name: update-context
tip: Verify the IP address of the running cluster against the IP in the kubeconfig, and correct the kubeconfig if it's out of date.

next.name: version
tip: Print minikube version.

option.name: --components
tip: List the versions of all components included in minikube (the cluster must be running).

option.name: --output
tip: One of 'yaml' or 'json'.

option.name: --short
tip: Print just the version number.

global_option.name: --bootstrapper
tip: The name of the cluster bootstrapper that will set up the Kubernetes cluster.

global_option.name: --help
tip: Help for minikube.

global_option.name: --profile
tip: The name of the minikube VM being used. This can be set to allow having multiple instances of minikube independently.

global_option.name: --rootless
tip: Force to use the rootless driver (docker and podman driver only).

global_option.name: --skip-audit
tip: Skip recording the current command in the audit logs.

global_option.name: --user
tip: Specifies the user executing the operation. Useful for auditing operations executed by 3rd party tools.

global_option.name: --v
tip: Number for the log level verbosity.
